title: Roasted Eggplant & Chickpea Salad
title_ru: Салат из запечённых баклажанов с нутом
summary: Warm or cold salad of roasted eggplant, red peppers and garlic with chickpeas and parsley. Very little oil, high in fiber.

nutrition.basis: per serving (~280 g), without bread and added salt

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: part for roasting, rest for dressing

shopping_list.note: drained weight needed; or 160 g dry, soak overnight and boil

shopping_list.item: Spices: salt, black pepper, smoked paprika

steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Drain and rinse 400 g chickpeas. Prick 2 whole eggplants (550 g) with a fork. Cut the top off the garlic head (45 g).
Rub the eggplants and 2 peppers (320 g) lightly with part of the 13 g oil. Wrap the garlic in foil with a drop of oil.
Roast everything on a baking sheet for 35–40 minutes at 220 °C, turning halfway. Check the garlic at 25 minutes and remove once soft. Larger eggplants need more time.
While roasting: chop 40 g parsley. When the peppers are done and cool enough, peel, seed and chop them to chickpea-sized pieces; put in the bowl with the chickpeas.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins, mash with a fork and add to the bowl.
Cool the eggplants until safe to handle. Peel, cut off stems, finely chop the flesh, drain the juice, add to the bowl.
Add the parsley, the rest of the oil, salt, pepper and optionally 15 g lemon juice. Mix and taste. Serve warm or chilled, with bread or in wraps.
tips: Chickpeas stay whole — do not chop them.
For a juicier salad add 1–2 more tbsp olive oil.
Tastes even better the next day.
Peeled eggplant gives a dip-like texture; keeping the skin adds more smoky flavor.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days.

source.note: Quantities and nutrition from the author's blog
